title: J'envoie, j'ouvre, j'offre
summary: Handle changing y spellings and -ir verbs with present endings like parler.
objectives: Conjugate -oyer, -uyer and -ayer verbs with accepted spelling variants.
Use complete ouvrir, offrir, souffrir and cueillir families.

sources.label: Public A2 index: topic-coverage reference only

sections.title: A changing stem, not a new tense
paragraphs: The stem is the part before a verb's ending. In the present, -oyer and -uyer change y to i before a silent e, but keep y in nous and vous. -Ayer permits either y or i in those same singular and third-person plural forms. The meaning does not change. Envoyer means send; essuyer means wipe or dry; payer means pay; nettoyer means clean; appuyer means press or support.
points: Envoyer: j'envoie, tu envoies, il/elle/on envoie, nous envoyons, vous envoyez, ils/elles envoient.
Essuyer: j'essuie, tu essuies, il/elle/on essuie, nous essuyons, vous essuyez, ils/elles essuient.
Payer: je paie/paye, tu paies/payes, il/elle/on paie/paye, nous payons, vous payez, ils/elles paient/payent. Nettoyer follows envoyer; appuyer follows essuyer.

examples.english: I am sending the estimate this morning.

sections.title: Some -ir verbs use -e, not -is
paragraphs: An infinitive is the dictionary form, such as ouvrir, 'to open'. Offrir means offer; souffrir means suffer; cueillir means pick; accueillir means welcome. These -ir verbs do not follow finir. Their present endings are -e, -es, -e, -ons, -ez, -ent. Keep the family stem shown below. Découvrir (discover) and recouvrir (cover) follow ouvrir; recueillir (collect or take in) and accueillir follow cueillir.
points: Ouvrir: j'ouvre, tu ouvres, il/elle/on ouvre, nous ouvrons, vous ouvrez, ils/elles ouvrent.
Offrir: j'offre, tu offres, il/elle/on offre, nous offrons, vous offrez, ils/elles offrent.
Souffrir: je souffre, tu souffres, il/elle/on souffre, nous souffrons, vous souffrez, ils/elles souffrent.

Cueillir: je cueille, tu cueilles, il/elle/on cueille, nous cueillons, vous cueillez, ils/elles cueillent. Accueillir: j'accueille, tu accueilles, il/elle/on accueille, nous accueillons, vous accueillez, ils/elles accueillent.

examples.english: We offer the volunteers a meal.

examples.note: Literally, are you suffering from back trouble?

examples.french: Ils **cueillent** des pommes et nous **accueillons** les visiteurs.
examples.english: They pick apples and we welcome the visitors.
examples.note: Both verbs keep the cueill spelling.

mistakes.why: Ouvrir does not take the finir pattern.

practice.prompt: Supply envoyer in the present: Tu ___ une photo.
practice.explanation: Y becomes i before silent e.

practice.prompt: Supply payer in the present: Elle ___ le loyer.
Supply ouvrir in the present: Nous ___ à neuf heures.
Supply offrir in the present: Vous ___ un service utile.
Supply nettoyer in the present: Les enfants ___ la table.
practice.explanation: Third-person plural changes y to i.

practice.prompt: Supply essuyer in the present: Nous ___ le comptoir.
Supply appuyer in the present: J'___ sur ce bouton.
Supply découvrir in the present: Je ___ ce quartier.
Supply souffrir in the present: Ils ___ de la chaleur.
Supply cueillir in the present: Vous ___ des fraises.
Supply accueillir in the present: Tu ___ la nouvelle équipe.
Supply payer in the present: Les clients ___ en ligne.
practice.explanation: Both third-person plural variants are accepted.

practice.prompt: Correct the verb only: Vous envoiez une confirmation.
Supply recouvrir in the present: La neige ___ le toit.
Supply recueillir in the present: Nous ___ les avis.
practice.explanation: The family stem ends in cueill-.

practice.prompt: Supply offrir in the present: J'___ mon aide.

production_task.prompt: Write a short update about welcoming visitors at a community event. Mention an invitation, an opening and something offered.
production_task.model_answer: Nous envoyons les invitations aujourd'hui. Demain, nous ouvrons la salle à dix heures. J'accueille les familles et nous offrons du café.
production_task.translation: We are sending the invitations today. Tomorrow, we open the room at ten. I welcome the families and we offer coffee.
rubric: Make the responsibilities and time clear.
